hil.evidence: One bench zone on one Raspberry Pi 4: control and circuit legs proven and a binding brought into force, then revised through the operator CLI (runtime docs/evidence/2026-09-22-pi4-circuit-leg-proof.md and docs/evidence/2026-09-23-pi4-revision-ceremony.md).

notes: Created by the baseline audit of v1 as the destination of its semantic post-freeze hunks: the limiting-element amendment, controller loss as five conditions, and the revision rule with its corpus and misreadings table. The text is v1's as it stood on main at 7d9a6e8, the last commit that wrote it. Provenance, stated exactly: runtime v2.5.0-rc.11 and the CLI's default branch vendor that revision under the v1 file names, their manifests pin source commit 7d9a6e8 with binding-vectors-v1.json and revision-misreadings-v1.json, the CLI's copy of the corpus names commissioned-safety-binding/v1.md, and the runtime's capability matrix at rc.11 names v1 in a Partial row; no artifact names v2, and none of this is a claim to it. The version is frozen by that shipment because the rule freezes a version at shipment whether or not it was claimed, and its bytes and behaviour are this text. Its baseline at the freeze revision is the v1 file at that revision, recorded as baseline_path, and its corpus is recorded through baseline_files.
